c.v: ESP32-S3 can access the external memory via one of the three ways illustrated in Figure 15.5-1 below.

blocks.alt: Figure 15.5-1. Three Ways to Access External Memory
blocks.caption: Figure 15.5-1. Three Ways to Access External Memory

c.v: SPI1, CACHE or GDMA must be configured with specific permission before accessing external memory. see illustration in Figure 15.5-1:
Box 0 checks the CPU's access to external flash and SRAM
Box 1 checks GDMA's access to external SRAM
Box 2 checks CPU's access to external flash and SRAM via CACHE
